title: Reusable UI Components for Job Node Split
description:
Create 4 new reusable UI components needed by the job node split config panels.

**Files (all NEW):**
- `dashboard/src/components/ui/CollapsibleSection.tsx` — Labeled expand/collapse group. Props: `title`, `defaultOpen`, `children`, optional `badge`. Uses ChevronDown icon with rotate transition.
- `dashboard/src/components/ui/TagInput.tsx` — Multi-value input for string arrays (risk_tags, requires). Renders values as Badges with X remove. Enter/comma commits. Props: `value: string[]`, `onChange`, `suggestions?`, `maxTags?`.
- `dashboard/src/components/ui/KeyValueEditor.tsx` — Dynamic key-value pairs for labels. Row of key Input + value Input + remove. "+ Add" button. Max 50 pairs, key max 64 chars, value max 256 chars.
- `dashboard/src/components/ui/TokenBudgetGroup.tsx` — Three linked number inputs (input/output/total tokens) with visual ratio bar. Auto-calculates total. Min 0, max 1M, step 100.

**SECURITY:** All text rendered as JSX nodes. TagInput suggestions from typed API data only. KeyValueEditor enforces length limits client-side.

**Pattern:** Follow existing UI primitives in `dashboard/src/components/ui/` (Badge, Input, Select, etc.).
definitionOfDone: CollapsibleSection renders with title, chevron toggle, expand/collapse animation
TagInput renders tags as Badges, supports Enter/comma to add, X to remove, optional suggestions
KeyValueEditor renders dynamic key-value rows with add/remove, enforces max 50 pairs and char limits
TokenBudgetGroup renders 3 linked number inputs with auto-total calculation and ratio bar
All components use existing Tailwind classes and design tokens (text-ink, bg-surface2, border-border, etc.)
